title: M/S Subodh Gautam Aarya Rice Mile v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Siddhartha Varma, J.; Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; relegated to clause 6.5; recovery stayed two months.
headnote: A rice mill challenged a recovery citation of Rs. 13,75,425 and sought instalments after disputing a March 2024 bill. The Division Bench did not decide merits. If the petitioner objects under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within ten days, the Department shall decide the objection within one month; recovery is stayed for two months.
facts: The petitioner rice mill sought certiorari to quash a recovery citation dated 16.07.2024 for Rs. 13,75,425 issued by the Executive Engineer, Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Khand, Atarra, District Banda, and a mandamus to pay in easy instalments. The Electricity Department produced a bill dated 06.03.2024 and stated the connection had been temporarily disconnected. The petitioner disputed the bill and sought rectification; Department counsel said an objection could be raised under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: A consumer disputing a recovery citation and seeking bill rectification may be relegated to Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005: if an objection to the bill is filed within ten days, the Electricity Department shall decide it within one month, and no recovery shall be made for two months.

not_decided.point: Merits of the disputed bill and recovery citation
not_decided.note: Court expressly stated it had not decided the case on merits.
